turns.question: What share of the outreach messages we sent from 1 to 3 October 2026 got a reply?
turns.answer: The reply rate for outreach messages sent from 1 to 3 October 2026 was 0.667 (66.7 %, messages replied over messages sent for the whole period). Late: partner_outreach.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
